evidence.excerpt: Kiss has collaborated with a regional energy distributor and a water utility as monitoring data partners on two funded projects, providing practical validation of research methods on operational infrastructure. She has carried out paid consulting for a mid-size automation integrator on specifying anomaly detection requirements for a SCADA upgrade project.
